title: Green Room Run - 1:1 Prep & Weekly Launch Notes
content:
Purpose: quick, portable notes for 1:1s with owners before the weekly release train green-room. Not a final runbook — personal prep + action tracker. Keep short, call out blockers I need to unblock or escalate during Friday sync.

Meeting plan (10–15m each owner):
- Check status (OK / at-risk / blocked) — one-line summary
- Critical open actions (what they will do before next sync)
- Tests passing / failing (smoke, e2e, infra)
- Rollout readiness: migrations, flags, capacity, fallbacks
- Escalation needs (who to page, thresholds)

Go/No-Go quick criteria (my shorthand):
- Safety: DB migrations green on staging + can be reverted (yes/no)
- Traffic: Dedicated capacity validated for 99th p50 latency targets under synthetic load (yes/no)
- Quality: Smoke prompts >= 90% acceptable for two sample flows (yes/no)
- Observability: Tracing + token-cost metrics wired + alerting enabled (yes/no)
- Rollback: a tested automated rollback or traffic shift ready (yes/no)
If any = no -> call no-go and list blocking ticket(s).

Owners + prep notes (1:1 checklist)
- Owen Patel (serving-runtime) — status: AT-RISK
  - Why: CUDA kernel regression in canary (PR 812) caused 3–7% perf variance under long-context tests.
  - Must-have: PR 812 merged + perf bench run by Thu EOD. If variance >3% need quick revert plan.
  - Tests: long-context perf run (bench-id bench/LONG/2026-03-05) — failing tail.
  - My ask: confirm benchmark artifacts + link to perf dashboard; name on-call for kernel revert (Samir).

- Lina Gomez (deploy & infra) — status: AT-RISK -> WARM
  - Why: Dedicated pool autoscaler policy not tested against burst profile.
  - Must-have: run synthetic burst test at low risk window Wed morning; confirm autoscaler cooldowns and burst cap.
  - Contingency: if autoscale slow, we’ll pre-warm extra nodes (ticket INFR-4321).
  - My ask: provide pre-warm playbook and cost delta estimate for pre-warm.

- Samir Rao (data migrations & DB) — status: OK
  - Migration plan: two-phase migrator with dual-write. Dry-run on staging passed (2026-03-02).
  - Revert: feature flag can disable new field read path; db-backup strategy in SRE runbook.
  - My ask: attach dry-run logs to ticket REL-2194; confirm time to rollback (estimate 12–18m).

- PM (Alex Rivera) — status: OK
  - Launch scope locked? small content tweak might slip post-launch; confirm non-blocking.
  - My ask: finalize user communication blurb for intercom and status page.

Open risks & mitigation (quick):
- Kernel perf regression (sev: high) -> mitigation: revert PR 812, fallback to older kernel image; on-call: Samir; escalate to eng-leads if revert exceeds 30m.
- Autoscaler slow on burst (sev: medium) -> mitigation: pre-warm nodes + adjust cooldowns.
- Third-party auth provider rate-limiting during ramp (sev: medium) -> mitigation: throttle ramp, notify security and product.
- Monitoring gap for embed pipeline (sev: low) -> mitigation: add synthetic probe and dashboard tile before Thursday.

Action items (owner / ETA / status quick lines):
- Owen: run long-context perf bench + upload artifacts / Thu 18:00 / in_progress
- Lina: execute synthetic burst test Wed 09:30, share logs / Wed 12:00 / todo
- Samir: attach migration dry-run logs to REL-2194 / Tue 16:00 / done
- Maya (me): draft ops run script + paging matrix for green room / Thu 12:00 / in_progress
- Alex: finalize customer comms blurb / Thu 17:00 / todo

Smoke test checklist (my minimal set):
- API auth: token rotation + grant flows (pass)
- Chat gen happy path (streaming + tool call) (pass)
- Large-context tail request (<= SLO p99) (flaky)
- Embedding index write+query (pass)
- DB migration feature-flag switch-off (validated)
- Canary rollback test (manual trigger) (not tested) -> MUST test before green-room signoff

Rollout schedule (proposed):
- T-24h: final canary validation, enable tracing hooks
- T-6h: pre-warm nodes if needed, lock configs, freeze non-essential changes
- T-1h: smoke test run, DB migration dry run, alerting sanity check
- T-0: open window + incremental traffic ramp by 10% every 15m with health gates

Rollback playbook (short):
- Detect: health check or error rate > threshold OR manual opt-in from SRE lead
- Action: shift traffic to older model/region and re-enable fallback model variant (pre-registered in routing policies)
- DB: if migration caused issue, toggle feature-flag to read-old-path, run rollback migration from backup snapshot
- Communication: post to #release-ops and status.redwood.ai (update 5m after decision)

Notes to self (personal scratch):
- Bring laptop charger and backup battery to green room
- Keep hard copy of rollback steps (paper) — power can fail
- Call Samir 30m before T-0 to confirm DB snapshot readiness
- Remind Lina to annotate autoscaler playbook with quick commands for pre-warm

Questions to ask in each 1:1 (quick prompts):
- If you had to mark this release as ok or not at this exact moment, which is it and why?
- Top 3 things that could go wrong in first 2 hours post-launch?
- Which dependency outside your team are we counting on and how confident are you?
- Who do you ring if you need an immediate rollback? (Name + phone/Slack)

Session follow-up format (what I’ll send after the 1:1):
- One-line status (OK/AT-RISK/BLOCKED)
- 3 bullets: current blocker, mitigation, owner+ETA
- Attach logs / perf artifacts if relevant

Quick checklist before Friday sync:
- [ ] All owners updated status in the doc (I will copy into shared runbook)
- [ ] PR 812 perf artifacts linked
- [ ] Canary rollback test executed and results posted
- [ ] Autoscaler burst run logs available
- [ ] Post-launch comms approved by PM

This is my working pad — I'll convert to the shared runbook notes after the 1:1s and the Friday green-room. Keep it terse, prioritize unblock actions and clear owners.

End.
